_comment: Java pair: Spring GraphQL+plain Hibernate/Flyway vs Foundgine+JPA with foundgine-migrations. Same gate order. Not yet runnable: arm projects not built.

environment.note: Record host details and equal service cpusets; Redis is shared by the four arms and included in each arm resource sample.

java-baseline.schema_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_java_baseline -At < scenarios/schema_dump.sql
java-baseline.reset_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml restart java-baseline >/dev/null && sleep 8 && docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_java_baseline -At < seed/reset-java.sql >/dev/null

java-foundgine.schema_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_java_foundgine -At < scenarios/schema_dump.sql
java-foundgine.reset_cmd: docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml restart java-foundgine >/dev/null && sleep 8 && docker compose -f compose/keycloak.yml -f compose/supplychain.yml exec -T postgres psql -U benchmark -d sc_java_foundgine -At < seed/reset-java.sql >/dev/null
